Description: Legacy upload creates non-canonical ECG records that cannot produce a generated report
Root_Cause: Endpoint bypasses create_ecg_record and artifact storage
Impact: Users can upload an ECG then encounter report-context artifact failure
Recommended_Action: Deprecate the endpoint or route it through the canonical pipeline

Description: NCEP preprocessing artifact is stored but reporting SP reads raw canonical waveform
Impact: Duplicated compute and unclear preprocessing ownership
Recommended_Action: Document boundary or consume/reconcile preprocessed artifact

Description: No NCEP_SP_INTEGRATION_DATA_CONTRACT.md exists and no persistent typed result contract is found
Impact: Unversioned result compatibility and weak provenance
Recommended_Action: Create a versioned contract and persistence plan

Description: Formal SP Signal Quality Score has no formula or threshold
Symbol: What this integration deliberately does NOT include
Root_Cause: Biomedical delivery marks scoring not implemented
Impact: No clinically defined signal quality decision
Recommended_Action: Obtain formula thresholds and validation before implementation

Description: Clinical findings flags scoring interpretation and recommendations are intentionally absent pending medical confirmation
Impact: Generated reports are measurement-only for many expected clinical sections
Recommended_Action: Provide governed rules and validate separately

Description: Rhythm PR axes annotations classifications confidence and recommendations have no producing analysis mapping
Recommended_Action: Publish a field producer-consumer matrix and prioritize approved fields

Description: SP outputs are recomputed in-memory per report and not persisted with version/provenance
Recommended_Action: Define and implement persistent result if required

Description: ECG viewer does not invoke the available waveform endpoint for a selected record
Recommended_Action: Fetch and render the selected record waveform

Description: UI accepts EDF PDF PNG JPG and other extensions that canonical detector/parser does not support
Root_Cause: Accept attribute exceeds backend format registry
Impact: Users can select files guaranteed to fail ingestion
Recommended_Action: Restrict UI accept list or add supported parsers

Description: Doctors receive organisation-wide data rather than assignment-only data

Impact: Cannot classify as defect without policy
Recommended_Action: Decide desired scope and add endpoint tests

Description: Logout clears cookie without revoking the stateless JWT

Description: QTc and SAECG raw measurements lack a repository clinical validation source
Root_Cause: No medical reference or approval artifact in repo
Impact: Do not treat numerical output as clinical diagnosis
Recommended_Action: Validate against governed data and cite source
